ratings.notes: Good hop-by-hop structure with PMID citations. Distinguishes human vs animal evidence well. Truncated at end; misses some hops. Direct oncogenic route clearly separated.
Excellent hop-by-hop mechanistic coverage with epidemiologic, cellular, genomic evidence. Lacks specific PMIDs reducing grounding score. REVEAL-HBV and WGS claims plausible but unverified.
Acknowledges missing PMIDs honestly, which is good. But incomplete coverage of hops 2 and 3. Hypothesis section adds value. Overall thin mechanistic detail.
Best overall: clear hop distinction, labeled evidence types (human/animal/in vitro), specific PMIDs, testable hypotheses, direct and parallel oncogenic routes addressed comprehensively.

result.pairwise_reason: PP011-D provides the most complete hop-by-hop mechanistic analysis with explicit evidence-type labeling, specific verifiable PMIDs, testable hypotheses, and clear separation of inflammation-fibrosis-HCC cascade from direct viral oncogenesis, outperforming PP011-B (no PMIDs) and PP011-A (truncated) and PP011-C (incomplete).
